title: Reactor Terminal
caption: Reactor Terminal (V)
game_text: Plays on table. “Three” on Fear Is My Ally is treated as “Four.” You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. Opponent’s retrieval from Boonta Eve Podrace may not be canceled. While you occupy more battlegrounds than opponent, I Did It! is suspended.
lore: The Death Star has many terminals coupled to the main reactor for power distribution throughout the immense space station.
